subject: E-Commerce
title: AI Personal Shoppers
description: A 60-second lesson on AI Personal Shoppers.

hook.text: AI personal shoppers will know your size, style, & budget before you ask. Shopping becomes a conversation, not a search.

buildup.text: Current e-commerce requires you to search, filter, compare, and decide. AI promises to collapse that into one step.

discovery.text: Perplexity Shopping already answers 'find me running shoes under $120 with good arch support' with instant product.

twist.text: If AI picks products for you, brands can't reach you through ads. The entire marketing funnel collapses.

climax.text: AI personal shoppers hand the decision to algorithms. The question is who controls the AI—and who it really serves.

quiz.question: How could AI personal shoppers disrupt marketing?
options: If AI selects products directly, traditional ads and marketing funnels become irrelevant
